answer: AI agent economies can employ a Proof-of-Stake mechanism for Sybil resistance. Each agent's influence is tied to a staked amount of valuable network tokens. To overcome this, an attacker must acquire and stake sufficient tokens to establish a controlling presence, representing a crystal clear, immense capital expenditure. Overcoming this economic ridge is difficult, making it prohibitively expensive to simultaneously control many identities and reach the zenith of network influence.
